caption:
BLUF: the collection plan runs on a fixed schedule, not a headline cycle. Areas of interest stay under standing tasking whether or not anything is happening in them this week.

Most passes close with nothing to report. That is not downtime — it is the baseline getting re-confirmed. A quiet pass over a pipeline corridor or a flood-prone reach is still logged, graded, and checked against the last one.

The tempo does not spike for a crisis and go dark after. It holds steady across the season, across every area under watch, so that when something does deviate from baseline, there is a record to measure it against — not a guess.

card.headline: Most passes report nothing
card.sub: A quiet pass is still logged and checked against baseline. The collection plan holds steady across the season, not just during a crisis.

rationale: Demonstrates scale and discipline of continuous monitoring without disclosing any specific detection, location, or client, reinforcing credibility through operational tempo rather than hype.
